title: Could a Falling Penny Kill You?
text:
A penny is light and flat, so it tumbles, and air resistance caps its speed at roughly 50 mph. It would sting, not kill.

Follow for more what-ifs.

Source: https://mechse.illinois.edu/news/blogs/lethal-pennies-and-other-misconceptions
